name: Lever Donkey Calf Raise
how_to:
1. Set the Machine: Adjust the height of the padded lever so it rests securely on your lower back or hips when you bend over.
2. Foot Position: Stand on the calf block with the balls of your feet supported and your heels hanging off. Feet should be hip-width apart or slightly narrower.
3. Torso Alignment: Bend forward at the hips to about a 90° angle, keeping your spine neutral. The padded lever should rest across your sacrum or upper glutes, not your spine.
4. Starting Position: Drop your heels below the platform level to achieve a full stretch in the calves.
5. Initiate the Movement: Press through the balls of your feet to raise the lever by plantarflexing the ankles. Keep your knees straight throughout the movement.
6. Peak Contraction: At the top, pause for 1–2 seconds while actively squeezing the calves.
7. Controlled Lowering: Slowly lower the lever until your heels are below parallel to stretch the muscle fully.
8. Repeat: Perform the desired number of reps with controlled tempo and full range of motion.
